acceptance.title: Awaiting your acceptance

activity.promise_denied_overridden: Promise withheld {n} times — gate overridden, goal completed

analytics.empty: No goals yet — analytics will appear once you start running goals.

commands.createUsage: Usage: type /goal followed by what you want to accomplish.
commands.needSession: Start a chat session first — /goal operates inside an active session.
commands.noActiveGoal: No active goal in this session. Start one with the /goal command.
commands.objectiveUpdated: Objective updated. The model will be told on the next turn.
commands.paused: Goal paused — {turns}/{maxTurns} turns used. Resume with /goal resume.
commands.resumed: Goal resumed. The loop will continue on the next turn.
commands.streaming: The current turn is still streaming — let it finish, then run /goal.

config.adaptivePacingHint: The model suggests the next continuation delay (1–60 min); it can only slow the loop, never speed it below the minimum interval.
config.completionPromiseHint: When set, the goal only completes after the model emits this exact token in a verification turn — guards against false 'done' verdicts.
config.inlineStopHint: Appended to the system prompt. Example: 'or after producing 3 haikus'.
config.maxBudgetUsdHint: Hard USD ceiling for a single turn. The turn halts if its cost crosses this. 0 = no cost ceiling (turn + token budgets still apply).
config.maxJudgeFailuresHint: Consecutive JSON parse failures before auto-pause (fail-OPEN).
config.maxPromiseDenialsHint: Failed verification turns before the gate is overridden and the goal completes anyway.
config.maxTokensHint: Hard cap on cumulative tokens billed against this goal.
config.requireAcceptanceHint: A judged completion pauses for your accept / request-changes instead of finishing on its own.

console.activeEmpty: No active goals. Start one with the /goal command in a chat.

prefs.description: Choose where the console opens and how open goals sort.
prefs.title: Console preferences

console.subtitle: Persistent objectives the agent works toward automatically.
console.title: Goals

defaults.maxBudgetUsdHint: Hard USD ceiling for a single turn of a new goal. 0 = no cost ceiling (turn + token budgets still apply).
defaults.maxJudgeFailuresHint: Consecutive JSON parse failures before auto-pause.
defaults.maxPromiseDenialsHint: Failed verification turns before the completion gate is overridden and the goal completes anyway.
defaults.maxTokensHint: Cumulative input + output tokens billed against the goal.
defaults.maxTurnsHint: Hard cap on continuation turns for a new goal.
defaults.startPausedHint: When on, new goals require a /goal resume before the loop begins.

history.deleteBody: This permanently removes the goal and its activity log.
history.empty: No goals yet. Use the /goal command in a chat to start one.

judge.heading: Judge
judge.maxTokensHint: Cap on the judge's reply. The judge answers in one line — 200 is plenty.
judge.modelHint: Model that decides whether the goal is done. Leave on the chat model unless you want a cheaper/faster judge.
judge.promptOverrideHint: Replaces the built-in judge instructions. Must still ask for a one-line JSON verdict.
judge.providerHint: Provider id paired with the judge model. Leave blank to reuse the session / app provider.
judge.temperatureHint: 0 is deterministic (recommended). Higher loosens the verdict.

launcher.description: Persistent chat goals (ADR-0019). Set an objective with /goal and the agent auto-continues until a judge confirms it's done, or budgets / timeouts kick in.
launcher.title: Goals

pacing.adaptivePacingHint: New goals let the model suggest the next continuation delay (1–60 min); it can only slow the loop, never speed it below the minimum interval.
pacing.heading: Pacing
pacing.manualContinueHint: When on, the loop waits for you to click Continue on the goal pill each turn.
pacing.quietHoursHint: Pause auto-continuation during this window (uses your timezone).

quickCreate.description: Start a new goal in a fresh chat. The agent will work toward it automatically.

quickCreate.title: New goal

remote.failed: Couldn't reach the desktop — try again.
